title: Demonstration against gender-based violence held in Vienna

tea.why: Protesters marched on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to speak out against patriarchal violence.
tea.want: They demanded an end to femicides and violence against women.
tea.changed: Nov 25, 2026: Hundreds marched through central Vienna on Wednesday evening.

summary: Hundreds of participants took to the streets in central Vienna on Wednesday evening, November 25, 2026, to demonstrate against patriarchal violence and femicides. The protest coincided with the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women and marked the beginning of the annual campaign against gender-based violence. Chanting slogans such as "You don't kill out of love! Stop femicides," demonstrators marched along a route spanning from Mariahilfer Straße to Resselpark. Organizers had registered an expected turnout of 300 to 500 participants. Authorities responded by deploying over a dozen police vehicles to temporarily block streets along the demonstration route, while traffic warnings were issued in advance.
response: According to oe24.at, over a dozen police vehicles temporarily blocked streets along the demonstration route as the march proceeded.
